---
title: Generated Markdown is non-executable
---

# Generated Markdown cannot introduce a cell

The cell returns Markdown containing an executable-looking QMD fence.

```{python}
#| label: generated-markdown
from IPython.display import Markdown

Markdown(
    "```{python}\n"
    "raise RuntimeError('Generated Markdown must stay inert')\n"
    "```\n"
)
```
